name: rosetta-truth-table
code:
use default

union Expression is
    VARIABLE(name: string)
    NOT(operand: Expression)
    BINARY(symbol: char, left: Expression, right: Expression)
si

use PARSE = (value: Expression, next: int)
use SUBPARSER = (string, int) -> PARSE

skip(text: string, at: int) -> int =>
    if at < text.length /\ text[at] == ' ' then
        skip(text, at + 1)
    else
        at
    fi

parse_atom(text: string, at: int) -> PARSE is
    let start = skip(text, at)

    if text[start] == '(' then
        let inner = parse_or(text, start + 1)

        return (value = inner.value, next = skip(text, inner.next) + 1)
    fi

    if text[start] == '!' then
        let operand = parse_atom(text, start + 1)

        return (value = Expression.NOT(operand.value), next = operand.next)
    fi

    (value = Expression.VARIABLE("{text[start]}"), next = start + 1)
si

parse_binary(text: string, at: int, symbol: char,
             below: SUBPARSER) -> PARSE
is
    let node mut = below(text, at)

    do
        let cursor = skip(text, node.next)

        if cursor >= text.length \/ text[cursor] != symbol then break fi

        let right = below(text, cursor + 1)

        node = (value = Expression.BINARY(symbol, node.value, right.value),
                next = right.next)
    od

    node
si

parse_and(text: string, at: int) -> PARSE =>
    parse_binary(text, at, '&', parse_atom)

parse_xor(text: string, at: int) -> PARSE =>
    parse_binary(text, at, '^', parse_and)

parse_or(text: string, at: int) -> PARSE =>
    parse_binary(text, at, '|', parse_xor)

names(expression: Expression) -> Pipe[string] is
    case expression
    when leaf: Expression.VARIABLE then
        yield leaf.name
    when negation: Expression.NOT then
        yield in names(negation.operand)
    when pair: Expression.BINARY then
        yield in names(pair.left)
        yield in names(pair.right)
    esac
si

evaluate(expression: Expression, values: MAP[string, bool]) -> bool =>
    case expression
    when leaf: Expression.VARIABLE then
        values[leaf.name]
    when negation: Expression.NOT then
        !evaluate(negation.operand, values)
    when pair: Expression.BINARY then
        let left = evaluate(pair.left, values) in
        let right = evaluate(pair.right, values) in
        case pair.symbol
        when '&' then left /\ right
        when '|' then left \/ right
        else left != right
        esac
    esac

digit(value: bool) -> string => if value then "1" else "0" fi

table(source: string) is
    let expression = parse_or(source, 0).value
    let variables = names(expression) |> distinct() |> collect()

    write_line("{source}")
    write_line("  {variables |> join(" ")} | result")

    for row in 0..(1 << variables.count) do
        let values = MAP[string, bool]()

        for column in 0..variables.count do
            let bit = variables.count - 1 - column

            values[variables[column]] = (row >> bit) & 1 == 1
        od

        let inputs = variables |> map(name => digit(values[name]))

        write_line("  {inputs |> join(" ")} | "
                   "{digit(evaluate(expression, values))}")
    od

    write_line()
si

["A & B", "A ^ B ^ C", "A & (B | C)", "!A | B", "(A | B) & (C | D)"]
    |> each(table)
